title: ItzRealism
description: A hardcore, realism-focused Minecraft modpack where survival is challenging and immersive. Manage temperature, hunger, and resources, progress through primitive to advanced technology, and explore a dynamic world where every decision matters.
body:
Step into a harsher, more immersive version of Minecraft where survival feels earned, not given. This realistic modpack transforms the familiar blocky world into a living, breathing environment where every decision matters.

From the moment you spawn, nature is no longer just scenery—it’s a system you must understand. Seasons change, temperatures fluctuate, and weather can become a genuine threat. You’ll need to dress appropriately, manage body heat, and prepare for brutal winters or scorching summers. Food is no longer instant fuel; it spoils over time, requires proper preparation, and a balanced diet becomes essential to stay healthy.

Progression is slower and more grounded. Instead of punching trees and instantly crafting tools, you’ll start with primitive methods—knapping stones, crafting basic tools by hand, and gradually advancing through more complex technologies. Mining is deeper and more dangerous, with cave-ins, limited visibility, and the constant risk of getting lost in sprawling underground systems.

Building also takes on new depth. Structures are affected by physics and structural integrity, encouraging thoughtful design rather than floating creations. Materials matter—wood rots, metals corrode, and reinforced builds become necessary for long-term survival.

Wildlife behaves more realistically, with animals acting on instinct rather than wandering aimlessly. Hunting requires patience and strategy, while farming demands planning, irrigation, and protection from the elements.

Exploration is slower but far more rewarding. With enhanced world generation, vast landscapes, and rare, meaningful resources, every journey feels like a true expedition. You’ll prepare supplies, map your routes, and face the unknown with caution.

This isn’t just Minecraft—it’s a grounded survival experience where creativity meets realism. Every system is designed to challenge you, immerse you, and make every achievement feel truly earned.
